boilerplate_excluded.text: GreenLoop Packaging is a mid-sized manufacturer of compostable food containers based in Pune, India.

Over the last three years its revenue has grown by 18% annually, but gross margin has fallen from 34% to 27% because the price of its main input, sugarcane bagasse, has risen while large restaurant-chain customers have demanded lower prices.

The CEO is deciding between three options: (a) build a second plant closer to the sugarcane belt, (b) sign a long-term supply contract with a single bagasse supplier, or (c) develop a premium product line for health-conscious retail consumers.

Instructions: Your submission must (1) identify the core problem, (2) evaluate each option against cost, risk and speed, (3) recommend one option with a clear implementation plan, and (4) list the assumptions on which your recommendation depends.
